result.instructions: OpenECraft is an electrical CAE (schematic) editor. Open or create a project first (open_project, new_project); the tools change it in memory until save_project writes it, undo / redo revert single tool calls. Pages are A3 (420 x 297 mm, y downwards, 10 columns, 6 rows); positions snap to a 4 mm grid. Use list_symbols for symbol keys and connection points, get_page for positions and item ids, connect to draw wires between connection points (TAG:PIN, e.g. -K1:A1), check to find errors and report / export for the results. Device tags follow IEC 81346 (-K1 contactor, -S1 switch, -X1 terminal strip). Parts come from the project, the built-in catalog or the parts server (parts_* tools).
